scope: Compact index of ten explicitly requested historical attempts. Original artifacts are read-only; current scenario code is not substituted for missing historical ScenarioSource.py files.
interpretation_rules: stage_evidence copies completed proof entries and explicitly named successful raid-entry checks. Missing fields mean not recorded; no unrecorded extraction, sale or second raid is inferred.
failure_motion is the last complete motion JSONL record before failure cleanup, not a later final pawn snapshot.
Jump falling and landing observations are separate from the recorded chunk result. A landing does not imply original chunk completion or route success.
Jump recovery_basis identifies earlier evidence used to define the recovery, not the run in which the listed jump occurred.
A missing ScenarioSource.py is reported as unavailable; a recorded SHA alone does not reconstruct that historical source.

failure_background.evidence: Report.json:overnight_route.jumps[5], OvernightMotion.jsonl final record, archived ScenarioSource.py:310-337
failure_background.interpretation: The sixth jump has recorded falling and landing at original target index 263. The later grounded observation is still on that target, with walk progress 3/4 and no original chunk completion. Its trigger was behind the incoming edge start, so clamping discarded the negative initial projection. The observed XY displacement exceeds 25 cm but the clamped polyline delta is only 14.69 cm; the same-target observation also fails the completed-original-point alternative. The scenario raised the recorded assertion. These geometric values do not change the failed result or establish completion of the chunk, bridge or route.
